meta.name: Anamika 2022
meta.description: Chase of an intelligent agent..., Sunny(Anamika) who forgot her own past, and no one knows the ultimate truth about her. Will Anamika be able to save herself from these powerful forces? It's time for Anamika to fight her past and solve it.

videos.title: Anamika… Who?
videos.overview: It begins with an attack on the Faridabad City Hospital by some masked goons. Anamika is a witness and somehow manages to save herself. This triggers Anamika's amnesia and she gets worried, however, Dr. Prashant, Anamika's boyfriend tells her not to worry about her past. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, someone catches sight of Anamika on the news and is startled to see her alive. Another attack on Anamika leaves her with nothing and she vows to take revenge on people who took everything from her.

videos.title: Known - Unknown Enemies
videos.overview: Anamika's instincts help her find the first name on her list. Meanwhile, her enemies are alarmed, keep an eye on her every move and wait with bated breath. There is also a sudden stir in the secret agency that seems to know Anamika. While Anamika gets close to her first target, the secret agency keeps tabs on her every movement.

videos.title: King Of Dope
videos.overview: Nobody has any idea about Anamika's whereabouts or her next move. When Walia, another partner of Ansari and Luthra, enters the scene, it is clear that the drug cartel is not just a local business. It is bigger than anyone's expectation and there is someone else, who controls them. Rhea, a DCA agent, surprises Anamika. Meanwhile, someone else is also looking for Anamika.

videos.title: DCA - My Old Friend
videos.overview: Anamika on the run after ending Ansari's life. However, before she reaches Delhi, her hideout is ambushed by Rhea. Meanwhile, Anamika has become a major hindrance in Sameer Oberoi and Walia's plans, resulting in tension between the two. On the other hand, Ravi Shrivastav, the head of the secret agency DCA, meets Raghunath Chauhan to discuss Anamika.

videos.title: I Want To Meet Mahie
videos.overview: Anamika meets Rohan who tells her some surprising things. Anamika wonders why she had asked Rohan to make a painting of her in her past. The tensions build as Anamika destroys her enemies and crushes Sameer Oberoi and Minister Raghunath Chauhan's empire. Meanwhile, the DCA is trying every method and means to get to Anamika, who has already made her next move. Her search for Walia brings her across a nightmare that was long forgotten.

videos.title: Band Of Evil Brothers
videos.overview: Anamika's encounter with Sameer Oberoi reveals that she has something that he wants. Meanwhile, things get out of hand for Anamika and the DCA gets to her first before she could get to Sameer. In an attempt to end Anamika, Minister Raghunath, Walia, Sameer, and Ravi Shrivastav have a meeting. While in custody, Anamika is interrogated and Rhea plans to get to the bottom of this case.

videos.title: Eliminate Agent - M
videos.overview: Anamika is missing. Rhea finds out who is behind her abduction. Meanwhile, DCA finds out that Rohan has been helping Anamika so they decide to eliminate him. Anamika discovers her past identity and who she was before she lost her memories. However, there are still many questions left unanswered.

videos.title: The Painting Speaks
videos.overview: With Rohan's help, Anamika discovers the secrets that are hidden in the painting. However, everything falls apart when Rohan is attacked. Anamika and Rhea find out about Sameer Oberoi's hideout and catch him only to find out that he is not the real culprit.
